names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 9 Οκτωβρίου, «Δικαίων Αβραάμ και Λωτ του ανεψιού του», with the rank word left off; the page's own heading for him is «Δικαιος Αβρααμ».

attestations.note: Not on the Moscow Patriarchate’s list for 21 August (Julian) — days.pravoslavie.ru, read 2026-08-23; no other day checked.
Not checked: doxologia.ro was read for 23 August – 19 September; its page for 21 august was not read (2026-08-23).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 9ης Οκτωβρίου — «Δικαίων Αβραάμ και Λωτ του ανεψιού του»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 9 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», and the Greek calendar keeps him with his nephew in one entry, «Δικαίων Αβραάμ και Λωτ του ανεψιού του». The page is a long retelling of Genesis — Terah, Nahor and Harran, Ur of the Chaldeans, Sarah, Isaac by Sarah, Ishmael by Hagar and six sons by Keturah, with chapter and verse throughout — and gives no year at all, so no `dates` object is proposed. It prints no hymn for him, only distichs for him and for Lot. Lot is drafted as a new folder in batch el-10-09. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The folder's Serbian row keeps him on 21 August and is untouched.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 03.09.2026 (21. август ст. ст.) — „Св. праоци Аврам, Исак и Јаков.“
